setup.completionSchedule: Independent seeded event sequence; each event completes one occupied court, then refills that court.
setup.coverageHistory: Completed matches only; active assignments are used by matchmaking and excluded from coverage.
setup.restDefinition: Completed-match events while available; players in an active match do not accrue rest turns.

skillProfiles.narrow: Shared latent rank profile 0..13; Social/Points strength 10+0.1×rank, Rating strength 900+4×rank (40 rating units per point).
skillProfiles.wide: Same latent rank profile; Points strength 10+1×rank, Rating strength 900+40×rank (40 rating units per point).

setup.pointDiff: 0 for all players; the benchmark has no match score outcomes.
